item_verdicts.write_paths: the source manifest declares reckon/velocity.py, the new test file, the fragment under docs/evidence/fragments/a-velocity-window-may-open-before-the-ledger/ and its figure directory; all three files in the diff are inside that set, and the figure directory stays empty because the done-when names no artifact.

justifications.durability: tests/test_velocity_reads_a_revision_without_the_ledger.py:194 asserts a None ledger digest for a head that predates the ledger and the recorded negative control shows that case reddening when the inline git show is restored, so the three cases are each falsified by the regression they guard; the weaker half, tests/test_velocity_reads_a_revision_without_the_ledger.py:182, compares the recovered commit against the head value the test itself fed in, and is not what the score rests on.
justifications.evidence: the head arm's "/home/ITER/mcintos/.config/reckon/crew/runs/r-20261017T112233609448-a-revision-without-the-ledger-reads-as-no-runs/gate-head.log" records 27 passed EXIT=0 against the base arm's 24 passed EXIT=0, so the gate measures the done-when, though the ruff clause is a manifest claim with no log behind it.
justifications.fit: the change follows the module's own idiom of a docstring stating the mechanism (reckon/velocity.py:710) and adds no symbol, filename or comment the naming rules forbid.
justifications.goal_fidelity: reckon/velocity.py:722 is now the module's only parse of the ledger bytes, since reckon/velocity.py:1191 keeps just the path string the git log search still needs, which is exactly the remedy the plan names.
justifications.reuse: the diff adds no definition at all, routing both reads through the module's existing read_blobs (reckon/velocity.py:395) and _blob_sha (reckon/velocity.py:689); a capability search over reckon/ledger.py, reckon/crew/obligations.py, reckon/cli_entry.py and reckon/mcp.py found no other revision-scoped ledger reader to extend.
justifications.scope_discipline: every path in the diff (reckon/velocity.py, the new test file, the fragment) is inside the declared write paths, but the fragment carries evidence prose where the node contract says a node whose done-when names no artifact writes none.
